_comment: Canonical doc sections one repo restates from the other. On CI the checker re-hashes each canonical section; a mismatch means the source changed and the listed mirror needs review. It flags, it does not auto-edit. After reconciling the mirror, re-baseline: python tools/docsync/check.py --update --repo esp32-leshy2=<path> --repo esp32-leshy2-firmware=<path>
